remarks: NEWLY RENOVATED 2bed 1.5bath CORNER UNIT in PRIME LOCATION! Welcome to this stunning corner unit, where modern upgrades meet unbeatable convenience. This 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom condo has been meticulously updated from top to bottom, featuring new flooring, sleek bathrooms, and a stylish kitchen complete with brand-new appliances. The dimmable recessed lighting throughout creates a bright and airy atmosphere, with natural light pouring in from the many windows that come with being a corner unit.  Located just steps from Norwalk Hospital, within walking distance to SoNo Mall, and only two miles from the East Norwalk train station, this home is perfect for commuters. The building also features an ELEVATOR, and as a tenant, you'll enjoy beach rights-offering the best of comfort and convenience!    This is an exceptional opportunity to live in a beautifully updated condo in a prime location. Submit your application today!  Comes with 2 parking spots. No animals.No smoking. Must have good credit and clean background check.  Credit and background check via Rentspree required.
